name: link
title: Link
description: Text that goes somewhere, in the ink of its sentence.
use: Navigation written as words in a sentence, on an a. On a button it is an action inside a sentence, such as "Undo".

instead.when: The navigation should look like a control
The words name a person, a team or an issue
The links are the path to the current page

keyboard.action: Follows the link, as the native element does

classes.name: link
classes.description: An underlined link in strong ink; the line takes the full ink under the pointer

classes.name: link-quiet
classes.description: Inherits its color and shows no line until touched, for footers, metadata and navigation lists

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or disabled on a button: disabled ink and no line

states.name: new tab
states.description: Draws a small arrow after the text; say "opens in a new tab" in the link's name too
